mapper.insert: INSERT INTO resource_pool (id, name, description, department_code, department_name, pool_mode, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{name}, #{description}, #{departmentCode}, #{departmentName}, #{poolMode}, #{status}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.update: UPDATE resource_pool SET name = #{name}, description = #{description}, department_code = #{departmentCode}, department_name = #{departmentName}, pool_mode = #{poolMode}, status = #{status}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM resource_pool ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT rp.* FROM resource_pool rp JOIN resource_pool_physical_cluster rppc ON rp.id = rppc.resource_pool_id WHERE rppc.physical_cluster_id = #{physicalClusterId} ORDER BY rp.created_at DESC
SELECT physical_cluster_id FROM resource_pool_physical_cluster WHERE resource_pool_id = #{resourcePoolId}
